title: Internal: Activating a Debit Card
summary: Provides the Rho-Bank procedure to activate a customer’s debit card, selecting the correct activation tool by card issue_reason (activate_debit_card_8291 for new_account/first_card, 8292 for lost/stolen/fraud, 8293 for expired/damaged/upgrade/bank_reissue). Requires customer verification, card in PENDING status and account OPEN, and uses last 4 digits, expiration date (MM/YY), and 3-digit CVV; PIN must be exactly 4 digits and not sequential/repeating. Notes: 2 incorrect detail attempts lock the card (branch visit); prior cards deactivate on activation (except reissued cards remain active 24 hours).
faqs: Which activation tool do I use for a new vs replacement vs reissued debit card?
What requirements must be met before I can activate a debit card (pending status, open account, not expired)?
What information do I need from the customer to activate the card (last 4, expiration date, CVV, PIN rules)?
What happens if the customer enters incorrect card details twice?
For replacement cards, what post-activation reminders are required?
For reissued cards, how long does the old card remain active and what must the customer update?
keywords: 2 incorrect details → card locked; branch visit
Reissued old card grace period: 24 hours
